issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When testing a Starlette application with normal cookies, everything works as intended. When setting secure=True, it breaks tests. The TestClient request context seems to lose information about cookies given to it via response, which breaks tests that depend on the cookie being resubmitted to the application.

### To reproduce

Python dependencies: `starlette`, `pytest`.

```
$ git clone https://github.com/kevr/starlette-secure-cookie-bug
$ cd starlette-secure-cookie-bug
$ PYTHONPATH=. pytest test
```

Problematic app route code and test:
- https://github.com/kevr/starlette-secure-cookie-bug/blob/master/secure_app/app.py#L8
- https://github.com/kevr/starlette-secure-cookie-bug/blob/master/test/test_app.py#L8

### Expected behavior

I expect the same behavior that `TestClient` uses for `secure=False` cookies; that is, they persist in the `TestClient` request context.

### Actual behavior

Cookie does not persist in `TestClient`.

### Environment

- OS: `Linux volcano 5.8.0-55-generic #62-Ubuntu SMP Tue Jun 1 08:21:18 UTC 2021 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`, Ubuntu.
- Python version: 3.9.5
- Starlette version: 0.14.2

### Additional context

This issue affects FastAPI directly, as `fastapi.testclient.TestClient == starlette.testclient.TestClient`.

FastAPI issue: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/issues/3339
issue.title: [Bug] Secure/HTTPOnly cookies untestable
